info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List P2m Healths-spec
info.description: The P2M Health Status API provides access to the health status of the P2M microservices. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current health metrics and status of the various services involved in the P2M ecosystem. Typical consumers include system administrators and monitoring tools that need to ensure service availability and performance. By querying this API, users can proactively manage service reliability and identify potential issues.

get.summary: Check the health status of the API.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to verify the operational health of the API. A successful response indicates that the API is up and running correctly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the health status of the application. It is essential for monitoring and ensuring the system is operational.

ListP2mHealthsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to health checks in the application.

status.description: The status of the health check, e.g., 'healthy' or 'unhealthy'.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the health check was performed in ISO 8601 format.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the health check response.

ListP2mHealthsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the successful response object for health operations.

responseId.description: Unique identifier for the health check response.

correlationId.description: Identifier for tracing requests through the system.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated in ISO 8601 format.

processingRegion.description: Region where the health check was processed.

HealthCheckMetadata.description: Metadata schema providing additional information about the health check.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme that uses JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for secure data transmission. Clients must pass the JWT token in the Authorization header to access protected resources.
